title: Review: the pampas, the Andes and Patagonia

items: I can talk about the regions of Argentina, from the pampas to Tierra del Fuego.
I can use *si bien*, *llegar a*, *sin embargo*, *a pesar de* and *terminar por* on these topics.
I can use the words for the pampas, wine, the Andes, Patagonia and the far south.
